# Reporting Security Issues

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in the ai-toolkit, we encourage you to let us know right away.

We will investigate all legitimate reports and do our best to quickly fix the problem.

Report security vulnerabilities through the [khulnasoft HackerOne program](https://hackerone.com/khulnasoft), or by email to [responsible.disclosure@khulnasoft.com](mailto:responsible.disclosure@khulnasoft.com).

https://khulnasoft.com/security
